turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’m concerned—I developed a sudden rash on the upper half of my back that started last night, and I’ve also had a new cough. I’m not sure what could have triggered it, and I’ve noticed mucosal changes as well.

No, I’m not sure if it’s Stevens-Johnson—I don’t know what would point specifically to that, just that the rash started suddenly last night on my upper back, and I’ve also had a new cough and mucosal changes. I haven’t noticed any new detergents or plant exposures.
